description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays a log view within a scrollable interface, handling log output and user interface setup.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that contains a LogView and manages its display within a ScrollView, including setting padding, typeface, and handling text changes to auto-scroll.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, padding, typeface, and other UI properties.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
